name: IST 407 — Group Project

vscode._comment_environment: This devcontainer is intentionally byte-identical to the individual student-template one (same Dockerfile, same requirements.txt, same VS Code settings) so a student's group environment matches their own. See student-template/.devcontainer/devcontainer.json for the reasoning behind useEnvironmentsExtension=false and the ipykernel<7 pin (the second-notebook stall).

postCreateCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory "$PWD" 2>/dev/null || true; python -c "import sklearn; print('IST407 group environment OK - sklearn', sklearn.__version__)"
